speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the onset of your gait and limb ataxia, and tell me about your significant medical history?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: When did these symptoms first begin, and have you noticed any other neurological issues like speech difficulties, vision changes, or headaches?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any fever, headache, or cognitive changes recently? I need to know if there are signs of an opportunistic infection.

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had a recent fever or major infection that I know of. The symptoms are mostly gait imbalance, limb ataxia, and weaker use of my right arm.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of Crohn's disease and natalizumab use, I need to urgently rule out progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML). REQUEST TEST: Brain_MRI_with_contrast.
